purpose: Federate verified GitHub, Git, Filesystem, and Lean-LSP development surfaces without collapsing remote commit authority, local revision state, working bytes, or Lean semantic state.
predecessors: KuuOS Development MCP Capability Registry v7.16
KuuOS Local Repository MCP Compatibility v7.18
KuuOS Repository Git Revision Adapter v0.83

planes.github_remote: remote repository, PR, Actions and collaboration state
planes.local_git: local revision, worktree and diff state
planes.filesystem: current working bytes inside the bounded repository root
planes.lean_lsp: Lean semantic observation bound to current file bytes

authority_order.lean_semantic_state: Lean-LSP observation bound to filesystem content digest

development_loop: bind Lean diagnostics to current file digest
continue local repair even when dirty if semantics are fresh
reconcile remote/local revision before remote mutation
use existing explicit GitHub/workspace authority for mutation
